proof_groups.proof_strategy: Adapt the complete same-shape xizi_double_link_next proof route. First add and prove the two pure group-suffixed helpers. Prove entail_wit_1 by anchor case split plus inductive segment split. Prove return_wit_1 directly from the empty sentinel segment; prove return_wit_2/3 with a local inductive segment join and empty/nonempty suffix facts; prove return_wit_4 by unfolding the first segment cell. Prove the two derived contracts by choosing the same abstract list, framing xizi_dll through the wand adjunction, and reducing dispatch by node=head or the spatially derived node<>head. Avoid every lemma in docs/forbidden_lemma.md and keep all non-pure spatial assertions local to witness proof bodies.
